source_routes: Exact 40 complete tapes from the frozen CR049 live-king episodes
purpose: Test a genuinely different architecture after CR049/CR050 falsified action-level behavior cloning. For each random season, evaluate all 40 coherent live-king routes against CR029. Measure the oracle portfolio upper bound, then learn only an initial-state route selector from information available before the first action. Tune k/categorical penalty/fallback threshold on a separate tuning panel; evaluate once on a larger untouched validation panel. If the selector fails while oracle is strong, the evidence points to within-episode adaptation rather than initial route choice.
